description: This file defines the ClaimRequestDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for ClaimRequest entities, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve associated data such as user, employee, currency, and expense totals, using various traits and services within the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: ClaimRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ClaimRequest entity, providing helper methods to set related data, retrieve expenses, and formatted dates, utilizing multiple traits and external services within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PayGradeService using the dependency container.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Protected getter for the associated ClaimRequest entity.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the User associated with the ClaimRequest based on user ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency type for the ClaimRequest based on currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the CurrencyType object based on a currency ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the ClaimRequest based on employee number.

methods.name: getTotalExpense
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total expense for the claim request.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted submitted date of the claim, or null if none.
